message.content: {"A0100":"A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce direct exposure after committing a missile without abandoning the engagement, by converting its fast northbound descent into a sustained hard-right eastward break; its ammunition decrease and missile appearance immediately precede the maneuver as the opposing formation also launches.","A0200":"A0200 most plausibly seeks to keep the opposing pair under missile pressure while beginning to reduce head-on exposure, using a continued fast northbound descent to fire and then a shallow right offset; its missile expenditure precedes the gradual eastward drift, which remains much less pronounced than A0100’s break."}

answers.A0100: A0100 most plausibly seeks to reduce direct exposure after committing a missile without abandoning the engagement, by converting its fast northbound descent into a sustained hard-right eastward break; its ammunition decrease and missile appearance immediately precede the maneuver as the opposing formation also launches.
answers.A0200: A0200 most plausibly seeks to keep the opposing pair under missile pressure while beginning to reduce head-on exposure, using a continued fast northbound descent to fire and then a shallow right offset; its missile expenditure precedes the gradual eastward drift, which remains much less pronounced than A0100’s break.
